releaseNotes:
rc.7 — Update reminder & update mechanism

• Menu bar ↑ indicator when update available
• ⌘U manual check for updates
• NSAlert with Download / View ReleasePage / Later
• NSUserNotification auto-banner
• Dismissed-version tracking (no spam)
• Mock env-var DSH_MOCK_UPDATE_VERSION for UI testing
• Multi-source: GitHub Releases + manifest.json fallback
• Periodic background check every 4 hours
• Graceful shutdown
